title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 085
review_goal: Differentiate shopping bag, shopping cart, and shuffle variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Shopping bag with one rounded smile shaped inner cutout hanging below the top handle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a friendly shopping bag marked by the curved inner opening beneath the handle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain bag or the folded flap bag when the opening detail should not be the main distinguishing feature.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds the curved inner cutout inside the bag body instead of a plain front panel.

items.depicts_observation: Shopping bag with a folded top flap or lid drawn across the opening above the smile shaped inner cutout
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the bag to look more boxed in at the top with a visible flap over the opening.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain bag or the smile opening bag when the top edge should not look capped by a folded flap.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only bag variant with the extra cap like top edge above the inner curved opening.

items.depicts_observation: Wire shopping cart with a long rear handle and a rectangular basket and two small wheels under the base
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the cart to read as a simple rectangular wire basket with an extended rear handle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the slanted cart variant when the basket front should angle downward and the handle should sit more compactly.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the cart basket more rectangular and open with a longer trailing handle.

items.depicts_observation: Shopping cart with a slanted front basket wall and compact handle and two small wheels under a shorter base
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tighter cart silhouette with a more angled basket front.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rectangular cart when the basket should look flatter and the rear handle should extend farther back.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot tips the cart basket forward and shortens the handle compared with the first cart variant.

items.depicts_observation: Two crossing path arrows forming one X shape with both arrowheads pointing outward on the right side
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants shuffle to read as two paths crossing through each other before exiting rightward.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the split path shuffle when the arrows should run in separate parallel lanes instead of crossing as an X.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot crosses the shuffle paths at the center and sends both arrowheads toward the right.
